test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the grammatically correct sentence.**

A. Today is sixth day of our workshop. All the participants are highly enthusiastic.

B. Today is a sixth day of our workshop. All the participants are highly enthusiastic.

C. Today is the sixth day of our workshop. All the participants are highly enthusiastic.

D. Today is sixth day of our workshop. All participants are highly enthusiastic.
solution:
The correct answer is *"Today is the sixth day of our workshop. All the participants are highly enthusiastic."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We use the definite article **"the"** with ordinal numbers **(first, second, third, etc.) **and sequence words (such as next and last) that precede a noun.

 
 
• Example: *This is **the third**__ time you have been late.*
 
 
 
• The word** "sixth" **is an ordinal number, so we must use **"the" **before it.
 
• The phrase **"all the participants"** is either neutral in stress, or slightly emphasizes **"participants."**
 
• So,** "All the participants"** is the correct phrase to use instead of **"all participants."**
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct with proper capitalization and punctuation.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
